verdict.rationale: Preventing stored data from being used for AI training is a fair privacy question for a cloud storage service, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no documentation of an AI-training opt-out, a data-use control, or any training-related privacy policy for Drive. The items cover only uploads, sharing permissions, push notifications, storage plans, and unrelated community complaints.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
